activity_summary: At night you said the eight lines had not mended the company. Kemp has not been shown the book. Friday is the Knave. The king stays at the hedge.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the residue of the rehearsal and stopped.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Named as absent, and as not shown the book.
